code.r:
g = graph_from_data_frame(edges, directed = FALSE, vertices = nodes)
scores = betweenness(g, weights = NA)

top = tibble(code = names(scores), score = scores) %>%
  arrange(desc(score), code) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5)

apl = mean_distance(g, weights = NA)
code.sql:
SELECT code, COUNT(*) AS degree, SUM(weight) AS strength
FROM (
  SELECT "from" AS code, weight FROM edges
  UNION ALL
  SELECT "to" AS code, weight FROM edges
) AS ends
GROUP BY code
ORDER BY degree DESC, code
LIMIT 5;

code.sql:
SELECT code, COUNT(*) AS degree, SUM(weight) AS strength
FROM (
  SELECT "from" AS code, weight FROM edges
  WHERE "from" <> 'D32016' AND "to" <> 'D32016'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT "to" AS code, weight FROM edges
  WHERE "from" <> 'D32016' AND "to" <> 'D32016'
) AS ends
GROUP BY code
ORDER BY degree DESC, code
LIMIT 5;
